criteria in Article 57 and identified in accordance with Article 59(1) in a concentration above 0.1% weight by

allow safe use of the article including, as a minimum, the name of that substance in the Candidate List.

accordance with paragraph 4 of Article 7, if a substance meets the criteria in Article 57 and is identified in
accordance with Article 59(1) of the Regulation, if (a) the substance in the Candidate List is present in those
articles in quantities totaling over one tonne per producer or importer per year; and (b) the substance in the
Candidate List is present in those articles above a concentration of 0.1% weight by weight (w/w).

obligation to comply with the supply chain communication obligation under Article 31 of Regulation (EC) No.
